subject: Novum Health — change in travel plans, request to move onsite demo to hybrid
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novumhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Gray <tom.gray@novumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite demo next week — travel change

Hi Stephanie,

Quick update from our side — travel just shifted for the leadership team. Our VP of Product (Tom) has been pulled into a multi-site customer visit next week and will be on the road across the east coast from Mar 8–10. He still wants to see the demo but will only be available for a short executive summary chunk virtually. The rest of the team will still be onsite in our SF office.

Can we convert the onsite session on Mar 9 into a hybrid: have your in-person engineer present to the local team, run a live stream for Tom for the executive summary, and provide a full recording + slides? If that’s heavy, can we alternatively shorten the onsite to a 60–75 minute focused session and schedule a follow-up 30-minute call for the exec summary?

Attached is the internal agenda so you can see who will be local vs remote (Novum-Agenda.pdf).

Appreciate a quick note on what will work — Tom is firm on travel and won’t be back until Mar 11. Procurement will also likely start a contract review next week so we’ll need the recording/slides for stakeholders who miss parts.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Strategy
Novum Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo next week — travel change

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the agenda.

We can absolutely support a hybrid setup. Two practical options that cover your needs: 

1) Hybrid onsite (recommended): our engineer (Marcus) will be onsite to run the hands-on portion with your local team; Grace will host the live stream and moderate Q&A for Tom. We’ll record the full session and deliver the slides and a 10–15 minute executive-summary clip that Tom can watch.

2) Condensed onsite + executive summary: shorten the live onsite to ~60–75 minutes focused on the 3 highest-priority use cases from your agenda, then schedule a 30-minute exec summary with Tom the next business day. We’ll still record and share materials.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A (hybrid): Mar 9, 10:00–12:00 
- Option B (condensed + exec): Mar 9, 09:00–10:15 onsite; exec summary Mar 10, 11:00–11:30

Marcus and Grace — can you confirm you’re available for Option A? If not, share your windows and we’ll re-propose. I attached our latest demo deck (demo-slides-v2.pdf) to align expectations. Once Elena confirms we’ll send a single calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) that contains the hybrid link and recording permission notes.

Elena — which option do you prefer? If you want I can also record the executive summary as a short MP4 and upload to the drive for procurement.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 12:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Novum travel change — quick internal coordination

Marcus / Grace — forwarding Elena's note. TL;DR: VP will be remote; client wants hybrid or condensed.

Marcus — can you lead the on-site run-through if we do Option A? They have a handful of engineers and a product manager onsite (see agenda). No heavy infra changes expected; focus on latency/cost examples and the routing examples.

Grace — can you run the live stream, manage the chat/Q&A, and make the 10–15 minute executive clip during our wrap? If Marcus needs a short break I’ll step into the demo flow remotely for continuity.

If either of you are unavailable for the proposed Mar 9 10:00–12:00 hybrid slot, flag your free windows and we’ll push to the condensed option.

Also — note procurement will be starting contract review next week (Elena mentioned). If we record and upload the clip with a short annotation that calls out the SLA/retention sections, that may speed approvals.

Thanks — Steph

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novumhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Gray <tom.gray@novumhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo next week — travel change

Thanks, Stephanie — Option A (hybrid onsite) works best for us. Marcus and Grace, appreciate you covering the SF office and the live stream. Tom will join virtually for the executive summary at 16:00 PST on Mar 9 and will watch the recording for the rest. Please send the calendar invite with the meeting link and upload the slides to the shared drive after the session. Procurement will wait until they see the recording/slides before submitting redlines.

Action items from our side: I’ll confirm final attendee list by Mar 8 EOD and share any late schedule conflicts.

Thanks again — see you next week.
Elena
---
Thread notes: attachments referenced above (Novum-Agenda.pdf, demo-slides-v2.pdf, calendar-invite.ics). Quoted blocks preserve original timestamps and headers when applicable.
